providerProof.adapterTruth: The Gemini adapter is not merely present in source. The deployed function selects it at runtime, and both acceptance scenarios produced real streamed Gemini answers.
providerProof.openaiNote: OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL still exist as secrets but are not selected, because AI_PROVIDER is gemini and both Edge handlers refuse to dispatch unless AI_PROVIDER equals gemini and the model equals gemini-3.8-flash.

providerWireDefect.ownerChallenge: The owner refused a blind removal of additionalProperties, pointing out that the Gemini documentation lists additionalProperties and maxItems as supported, so a 400 did not prove those keywords were the cause. That challenge was correct and changed the outcome.

method.action: An offline wire diff rebuilt both final payloads through the shared converter and printed endpoint, model, generationConfig keys, schema shape and keyword counts.
additionalProperties was stripped and NEED retried. Still 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT, so the first hypothesis was refuted rather than confirmed.
The closed diagnostic vocabulary was extended with structural field paths. The provider then named the node: RESPONSE_FORMAT_MIME.

A control turn on the WORKER path, which had succeeded six times, now failed identically. Its only change was the redeploy onto the current shared helper, which proved the responseFormat wrapper itself was the defect.

providerWireDefect.rootCause: geminiRequestBody wrapped structured output as generationConfig.responseFormat.text with mimeType and schema. The generateContent API rejects that wrapper with INVALID_ARGUMENT on responseFormat.text.mimeType. The NEED path had always been deployed on the wrapper, and the WORKER path had not been, until the redeploy.
providerWireDefect.fix: Structured output now travels in the documented fields generationConfig.responseMimeType and generationConfig.responseSchema. Only additionalProperties is dropped, because it is outside that schema subset. enum, nullable, maxItems, minItems, minimum, maximum and the UPPERCASE type names are forwarded unchanged.
providerWireDefect.scope: Gemini wire adapter only. The internal NEED schema and validation contract stay strict, each caller's decoder still refuses unknown keys, the fact registry is unchanged and no canonical writer was touched.

credentialHandling.note: The harness performs a real email and password grant and verifies the resulting user id against /auth/v1/user before any AI call, so auth.uid() and RLS are genuine throughout.
